description: This file defines an interface `ConnectionFailure` within the `org.eclipse.ditto.services.connectivity.messaging.internal` package. The interface extends `WithOrigin` and declares methods for retrieving failure description and failure object when a connection failure occurs in messaging infrastructure.

classes.name: ConnectionFailure
classes.description: An interface representing a messaging internal error indicating a failure detected on a connection. It provides methods to obtain a description of the failure and the failure object containing the cause.

methods.name: getFailureDescription
methods.description: Returns a description of the connection failure.

methods.name: getFailure
methods.description: Returns the `Status.Failure` object that contains details about the cause of the failure.
